module: Loader of a rally's recce "cuts". A cut is a position marker where the co-driver made a voice recording during the recce. The module reads the mission's cuts file and attaches to it, if they exist, the transcriptions from the transcripts file. It is an extension (gameplay_rally_recce_cutsRecording), used by the recce class.
notes: The file paths come from rallyUtil.cutsFile(missionDir) and rallyUtil.transcriptsFile(missionDir); both files are in JSONL format (one line = one object).
A transcription is only kept if its cutId is a number > 0; it is attached to the cut whose id is equal.
The normalization word_map is currently an empty array (TODO in the code: to be reconnected when the work on freeform text resumes), so the text is not modified in practice.

load.desc: Loads the mission's cuts with their transcriptions. Each line of the cuts file becomes an object whose pos is converted to vec3 and quat to quat, with a transcript field added ({error, text} if a transcription exists, otherwise an empty table).

missionDir.desc: Mission folder containing the recce files

returns.desc: Array of cut objects; empty array (not nil) if the cuts file does not exist
